entwurf.thema: Claude Code for a Steam game: what the sources cover

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Can Claude Code build your Steam game? It reads your game's files, runs commands and makes changes for you.
teile.szene: Black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk in a neon city apartment at night, leaning toward a glowing monitor off-frame, medium shot, painted open-world-game poster style.

teile.name: Plan first
teile.text: Start in plan mode. Claude reads files without changing anything, so you review the plan first.
teile.szene: Presenter in cyan glasses and leather jacket sketches game level ideas on a whiteboard in a loft studio, thoughtful expression, medium shot, warm lamp light, painted urban game poster style.

teile.name: Add a check
teile.text: Then give it a check: run your tests, read results, iterate until they pass.
teile.szene: Presenter with cyan glasses nods with satisfaction while leaning back in a chair, city rooftop studio at dusk, medium close shot, bold ink contours and painted shading.

teile.name: Why checks matter
teile.text: Without a check, "looks done" is the only signal; you become the verification loop. For visuals, it can compare screenshots.
teile.szene: Tired presenter in leather jacket rubs his eyes at a late-night desk, city lights through window behind, medium shot, moody cyan glow, painted open-world poster style.

teile.name: Steam gap
teile.text: So what about Steam? It's Valve's PC game platform, but our sources don't cover publishing steps. Check Valve's pages.
teile.szene: Presenter in cyan glasses stands at a rainy city crossroads at night, looking toward a distant glowing storefront district, wide shot, painted urban game poster style.

teile.name: Honest limit
teile.text: The limit: context fills fast, and performance degrades. One outside test counted 33,000 tokens sent before a one-line prompt.
teile.szene: Presenter in leather jacket lifts a heavy overflowing backpack on a city staircase, strained but determined, medium shot, golden evening light, painted game poster style.

teile.name: Ending
teile.text: So, can it build your Steam game? It can write and check the code. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter with glowing cyan glasses smiles confidently on a rooftop overlooking a neon city skyline at dusk, medium shot, painted open-world poster style.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude Code can read files, run commands and iterate against tests or screenshots. Our sources don't cover Steam publishing steps, and one outside test measured heavy token overhead.
